meta.name: context-engineering-guide
meta.description: Analyze and apply context engineering principles to LLM applications. Use when the user asks about "context engineering", "context window management", "prompt vs context engineering", "how to structure LLM context", "RAG context design", or wants to optimize what goes into an LLM's context window. Also triggers on "context engineering vs prompt engineering". LLM 上下文工程分析框架：帮助用户理解和应用上下文工程原则，优化 LLM 上下文窗口的信息填充策略。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 优化 LLM 上下文窗口的信息填充策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在设计或优化 LLM 应用的上下文结构。
copy.tagline_en: Optimize how you fill the LLM context window
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing or optimizing context structure for LLM applications.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会分析你的 LLM 应用，诊断上下文窗口中的问题（如信息缺失、格式混乱），并给出优化建议。
howto.when: 当你询问“上下文工程”、“上下文窗口管理”、“RAG 上下文设计”等关键词，或想优化 LLM 上下文时触发。

say.text: 我的 RAG 聊天机器人经常答错，怎么改进？
say.note: Claude 会分析你的 RAG 流程，指出选择或压缩问题。

say.text: 帮我分析一下这个 LLM 应用的上下文架构。
say.note: Claude 会输出诊断报告和改进建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes your LLM application, diagnoses context window issues (e.g., missing info, inconsistent format), and provides optimization recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about "context engineering", "context window management", "RAG context design", or want to optimize LLM context.

say_en.text: My RAG chatbot often gives wrong answers. How can I improve it?
Analyze the context architecture of this LLM app.
say_en.note: Claude will output a diagnosis report and recommendations.
